params.name: destination
params.description: Array to which to copy (created or overwritten with source's contents, size, and type)

overloads.semanticRole: Creates or overwrites the destination array with an exact copy of the source array's contents, size, and type.

constraints: In compiled mode the destination array must already be of the same type as the source array (behavior is only guaranteed to match interpreted mode when types match).
Copying object/collection arrays duplicates only references, not the underlying objects/collections; use OB Copy to duplicate the objects themselves.
